title: Nested file assets fail when their destination parents do not exist
reasoning: File assets are copied directly to their configured save_path without creating its parent directories. A valid nested destination such as data/input.csv fails with FileNotFoundError in a fresh workspace. Directory assets use copytree and do not have this limitation.
reproduction: Prepare an empty agent-inference workspace with a file asset whose save_path is data/input.csv, then call materialize_assets().
recommendation: Create the file destination's parent directories before copying, subject to workspace containment checks.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Included materialization tests do not explicitly exercise a standalone file asset with absent nested destination parents; nested directory assets use a different branch.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand asset materialization coverage to nested file destinations with absent and existing parents, including repeated materialization.
